question: Does raw OPU RKS0 prove zero overall pitch dependence of envelope rates?
answer: Not established. Manufacturer pages define encoding and name, not the zero law. Captioned firsthand tutorial narration calls0 off; this supports intended off semantics for the adjustable RKS contribution but is not a controlled proof that the complete OPU EG has no residual pitch dependence.

recommended_discriminator.patch: Independently authored pure carrier, muted modulator, flat LKS, fixed TL/velocity, no chorus/vibrato/sustain/reverb for dry test.
recommended_discriminator.matrix: Same patch at MIDI36/48/60/72/84 (or adequate unclipped usable subset), rawRKS0 first, then rawRKS1..3, with repeated dry D2 and key-off segments at unchanged gain.
recommended_discriminator.measurement: Compare slopes, not threshold crossing times alone. Keep actual gates separate from audible arrival; simultaneous held control can check common gain changes.
recommended_discriminator.limits: Recover full rates/pitch law before attributing endpoint differences entirely to a fixed attenuation cutoff. No other chip family formula is imported.
